specs.rationale: Types the cash-conversion leg of the prose falsifier. The low case holds normalized owner cash flat at 70.0 JPY per share (low-case trace node normalized_owner_cash, kind=fact, locked in the fact ledger); a resolved value below that anchor means cash conversion worse than this low case. 'Materially' is not quantified in the contract, so the spec fires on any breach of the anchor. Due is the next expected interim disclosure (H1 FY2027, ~2026-10-30) plus 60 days.
